headline: Budget law, the courage of responsibility: today's consensus should not mortgage the future
summary: Commentary on Italy's budget law says an election-year budget will test political discipline, arguing that handouts make no sense and consensus should not mortgage the future.
why: The budget law sets Italy's tax and spending plans, which influence its deficit, debt trajectory and government bond yields.
